# Standard Error and t {#standard-error-t}

<div class="draft">Work in progress.</div>

## Standard Error By Simulation

- SD of the sampling distribution, by simulation
- rebuild the population and the 1000 sample means of 20 from Chapter \@ref(sampling-distributions) (one line of text in the book; code hidden or in the exercise file)

```{r rebuild-sample-means, include=FALSE}
population_scores <- rnorm(n = 10000, mean = 50, sd = 10)

one_sample_mean <- function(n) {
  one_sample <- sample(population_scores, size = n)
  mean(one_sample)
}

sample_means_20 <- map_dbl(1:1000, \(i) one_sample_mean(n = 20))
```

- compare with SD / sqrt(n): the standard error

```{r simulated-standard-error}
c(
  simulated = sd(sample_means_20),
  formula = sd(population_scores) / sqrt(20)
)
```

- `simulated` = SE estimated from the sample means just made
- `formula` = SE calculated from population SD and sample size (/ sqrt(20))

## From Standard Error To t

- t = distance from comparison value in standard errors
